biography: Nagendra Pavana is a Sanskrit scholar trained in traditional and modern systems of Vyākaraṇa. He studied at Om Shantidhama Gurukulam, Arsha Gurukula and Dattashrama, and completed a Ph.D. in Vyākaraṇa at Karnataka Samskrit University, Bengaluru. His work includes teaching Sanskrit grammar and developing Sanskrit e-learning resources with Vyoma Linguistic Labs.
researchOverview: His interests include Pāṇinian grammar, the Mahābhāṣya, Sanskrit poetry and aesthetics, Indian philosophy, the Vedas and Vedāṅgas, and Indian classical music.
